poems.title: Rainy Day Fun!
poems.description: A cheerful little poem about rain, boots, and puddles.

scenes.narration: Can you hear the raindrops tapping at the window today?
Put on your yellow boots and splash along the way!
Jump in a puddle, splash up high, then watch the clouds roll by!
Open your bright umbrella and walk with a happy smile.
When sunshine peeks through the sky, we can splash again! Did you hear the rain tapping today?

poems.title: Hello, Sunny Day!
poems.description: A bright and cheerful poem about starting a sunny morning.

scenes.narration: Can you see the golden sun shining in the sky?
Birds wake up and sing hello as fluffy clouds go floating by.
Stretch your arms and wiggle your toes, then smell the flowers as the garden grows.
The morning feels warm, bright, and new, with lots of fun for me and you!
Wave hello to the sunny sky and start your day with a smile. Can you see that golden sun shining high?
